cohort: 200 pregnant women with PROM at or above 37 weeks of gestation admitted to a government maternity hospital in Tirupati, India
finding: The cesarean section rate was 30.5%, maternal morbidity was 19.5% (10% febrile morbidity), perinatal morbidity was 24%, and perinatal mortality was 0.5%.
mod_finding: 31% of the participants delivered via cesarean section, with failure to progress (48.38%) and fetal distress (28.03%) being the main indications.
